Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game but do not go anywhere as the next game will begin shortly which will be played between New Zealand and Pakistan at Sharjah. That game will begin at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Switch tabs and do join us there. Till then, cheers!

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa, says that this game was much better than their first game. Mentions that the bowlers bowled really well and then the batters stepped up as well. Tells that they weren't sure how the wicket will react so they just decided to give it a go with Markram. States that their bowling has been well and good and Aiden has been hitting the ball wonderfully. Informs that losing a guy like de Kock is not good but at the end of the day, it was another game to play for the country.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, says that they did not bat well and it is very disappointing. Adds that they started well in the Powerplay but lost wickets later which hurted them. Tells that things like these happen and maintaining strike rate is difficult on these kind of wickets. Ends by saying that winning games is the main thing and they would not be thinking about the net run rate just yet.

Anrich Nortje is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH - He says that playing in the Indian T20 League helped a lot. Mentions that knowing the conditions and what to do and when to execute plans made it easy. Tells that the wicket was good to bowl on and it definitely paid out today. Also says that it is always good working with Rabada as his knowledge and ideas of the game is great. Adds that they were not close to a perfect game but they will try and give their 100 percent to have a perfect game and is hopeful that they can build on this.
....PRESENTATION TIME....
Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, the South African bowlers did really well to restrict Windies to an average total which was chased down by them with ease.

The Windies managed to take an early wicket but then could not keep the pressure going. They did not bowl all that bad but did give away a few loose ones and a few extras when not needed. The bowlers though can’t be blamed as they just did not have enough runs on the board on a wicket which got easier to bat on.

Quite an easy win in the end for South Africa. 144 was always under par and that was pretty much evident. The Proteas did lose Bavuma early but Reeza Hendricks and Rassie played really well to not only get the chase back on track but take South Africa on top. The two added above 50 before Reeza fell after a good knock. Markram though did not let the momentum slip away as he too played a brilliant knock and he along with Rassie have given their side their first win of the tournament.
Short of a length, on middle. Aiden Markram pulls it to deep square leg for a single. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 8 WICKETS!

SIX! Magnificent from Aiden Markram! On a length, on middle. Aiden Markram swivels and pulls it with disdain over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. He brings up his fifty as well. A monstrous 92 metre six! What a way to raise the fifty. Scores level now!
Full again from Dwayne Bravo, on the pads. Aiden Markram squeezes it out to long on. He keeps the strike. Just 7 needed from the final two overs.
Fuller in length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen digs it out on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, angling away. Rassie van der Dussen has a swing at it but misses.
A full toss on leg, worked to long off for a single.
This is pushed to deep cover for a single.

Very full, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen steers it to extra cover. Aiden Markram wants a single but is sent back by his partner. He dives to make it back to the crease. Andre Russell has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. No harm done in the end.
FOUR! Yet another full ball, outside off. Aiden Markram lifts it over extra cover and fetches himself a boundary. Another good over for the Proteas. Just 11 needed now!
Short of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it off the backfoot to deep point. A run.
On middle, jammed out to long off for one.

Full, outside off. Aiden Markram carves it to deep extra cover. Shimron Hetmyer from long off runs to his left and dives to stop the ball. But he has touched the ropes while picking up the ball. A boundary. A good effort from him nonetheless.
Full again, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen clogs the ball towards long off for a single.
Andre Russell fires a yorker, on middle. Aiden Markram jams it out to long off for a single.
Andre Russell (2-0-17-0) is back on.
Length ball, in the slot, around off. Aiden Markram eases it down to long off for a run. Just 23 runs needed now off 24 balls!
Slower ball, shorter in length, around off. Aiden Markram stands tall and punches it to the cover fielder.
A full toss, on middle. Aiden Markram misses out as he hits it straight back to the bowler.
Slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen reaches out and works it to long off for a single.
Helmet comes on for Nicholas Pooran which indicates that he will be standing up to the stumps now.

FOUR! BACK-TO-BACK BOUNDARIES! Rassie van der Dussen is playing a crucial knock for his side here! Full ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hits it back past mid off and collects another boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Slower ball, on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen skips down a bit and sweeps it into the deep square leg fence!
A low full toss, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and the ball goes behind square on the leg side for one. 33 runs needed off 30 balls!
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen miscues his pull and the ball goes to the mid-wicket fielder, on the bounce.
Wide! Full ball, way outside off. Rassie van der Dussen lets it through to the keeper. Wided!
Full ball, outside off. Aiden Markram squeezes it out towards long on and takes a run.
SIX! WOW! What a clean strike! Length ball, around off. Aiden Markram stays back and hoicks it way, way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. He is in some form!
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good-length ball, around off. Aiden Markram stands tall and works it to long on to collect a run.
Ravi Rampaul (2-0-11-0) is back into the attack.
Yorker-length ball, on leg. Aiden Markram digs it out to long on and takes a single. Brilliant over from Dwayne Bravo. Only 2 runs from it.
Leg bye! Full ball, around middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses his flick and gets hit low on his pad. The ball rolls away and they sneak in a leg bye.
Make that four dots in a row! Full ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Three dots in a row! Good-length ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen turns it to mid-wicket.
Slower ball, on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Full ball, outside off, angling away! Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and the ball falls just in front of the short third man fielder.
Dwayne Bravo comes back on. Gave away 8 runs in his first over.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to sweeper cover for a single. 46 runs needed off 42 balls now!
Russell bangs it into the deck, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen sways away from the line of the ball.
FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen stays back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Just short of the cover fielder! Slower ball, on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to flick but gets the leading edge which falls just short of Chris Gayle at covers.
Full ball, just outside off. Aiden Markram drills it to long on and rotates the strike.
Good-length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it to wide of cover and takes a run.
Andre Russell comes back into the attack. Gave away 10 runs in his first over.

SIX! That spoils the over and Markram is taking the game away from the Windies! Shorter and on middle, he stands tall and dispatches it well over the square leg fence for a biggie. 9 from the over. 53 needed in 48.
Yet another dot! Good stuff by Pollard! This lands outside off and cuts back in. Markram looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
A dot! West Indies need more of those! Length and on off, Markram looks to slap it but it hits the upper part and falls short of the bowler.
Sensible batting will do it! On off, Rassie plays it to long on for one omre.
On off, this is worked down to long on for one. The batters need not do anything silly now.
Shorter and outside off, Rassie guides it through point for one.
Kieron Pollard to operate now.

SIX! That is huge! The hit and the over. 16 from it and South Africa well and truly back on top. Just the 62 needed in 54. This is the googly, it is on off but way too full. Markram sends it sailing over the long on fence for a biggie.
On off, Rassie flicks it through square leg for one.
Markram wanted two againt! Tossed up nicely on off, Markram gets it past the fielder diving at covers. One.
Two more! Picking the gaps brilliantly is Markram! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point. Two taken.
Really nicely played! The paddle scoop comes out, he plays it from outside off towards fine leg for two more. 6 from the over already. 4 balls to go.
Brilliant running which means 4 from the first ball! On middle, this is worked through square leg for a brace.
TWO WIDES! Windies can't afford to give these extra runs! Down the leg side, Rassie misses the sweep, it hits the glove of the keeper and goes towards short fine leg for one.
This is eased down to long off for an easy single. 78 needed from 60 balls.
Short ball, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen makes room for himself and smashes it to mid-wicket. Kieron Pollard dives to his right and stops the ball. Excellent fielding from the skipper.
Loopy ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it on the leg side.
On the pads, Aiden Markram steps out and pushes it to long off for a single.
THREE WIDES! Flatter ball, down the leg side. Aiden Markram looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball and the batters sneak a couple of runs.

DRINKS! With that wicket, drinks are taken on the field now. After losing Temba Bavuma early, Reeza Hendricks and Rassie van der Dussen did really well to keep the scoreboard ticking and also brought their 50-run partnership. West Indies have got their man in the form of Reeza Hendricks who was looking dangerous but they need a few more wickets to turn the game in their favor. Aiden Markram walks out to bat now.

OUT! THAT IS AS CLEAN AS A WHISTLE! Fantastic piece of fielding from Shimron Hetmyer to bring West Indies back into this contest! Huge wicket in the context of the game as Reeza Hendricks walks back to the hut. He was batting with ease but this will give Windies the belief. Not the best of balls though, it is short and on middle, Reeza pulls it powerfully but flat towards deep square leg. Hetmyer runs in, dives forward and claims to take it. The umpires discuss and then take it upstairs with the soft signal being NOT OUT! Replays show that he has taken it inches above the ground. Can Windies build pressure from here?
Commentary.Howout: c Shimron Hetmyer b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Both umpires converge and send a catch referal upstairs. The soft signal is NOT OUT from Aleem Dar. Replay shows that Shimron Hetmyer's fingers are underneath and the third umpire signals it OUT.
Flatter ball, down leg. Rassie van der Dussen backs away and tucks it to deep square leg to rotate the strike.
Yorker-length delivery, around off. Reeza Hendricks jams it out to the cover fielder. 5 runs off the over!
Tossed up, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen turns it to the right of the bowler and takes off for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back and cuts it to deep point for yet another single.
Another single! Tossed up, around middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen skips down and whips it to deep mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks reaches out and carves it through covers for a single.
Floated, around off. Rassie van der Dussen gets low and reverse-paddles it to short third man. The batters cross for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and punches it to cover. Lendl Simmons there dives to his right and prevents a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks waits for it and lofts it over cover for a boundary. A timely boundary for the Proteas!
Full ball, angling in from middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it off his pads to deep mid-wicket and collects a run.
Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks tucks it to the leg side for one. South Africa bring up their 50!
Excellent comeback from Bravo! Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away late. Reeza Hendricks looks to block but it zips past his blade.
Wide! Bravo errs in line and sprays it down leg. Reeza Hendricks misses his flick. Wide called by the umpire.
Bravo starts with a length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen works it to long on and takes a single.
Dwayne Bravo comes into the attack.
A dot to end the over! Flatter ball around off. Reeza Hendricks punches it off the back foot to cover. Just 5 runs off the over!
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen gets low and eases it down to long on for a run.
Wide! Flatter ball, sprayed down leg. Rassie van der Dussen misses his nudge. Wide called!
A googly, shorter in length, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen fails to pick the variation and misses his flick.
Tossed up, outside off. Reeza Hendricks drills it to long off for a single.
Another flatter ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and works it to Lendl Simmons at deep point. A single taken.
Flatter ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Hayden Walsh to roll his arm now.

A single to end! A good over from Akeal Hosein! South Africa are quite similar to what Windies were after the first 6. They are 42 for 1. 102 needed in 84. The last ball is short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it into the wicket, on middle, Rassie nudges it through mid-wicket for another one.
Just the one! On middle, Hendricks works it through mid-wicket. They run the first one hard but settle for a single.
Reeza makes room but he is followed, it is pushed to mid off.
Now another one worked through square, closer to the fielder and hence, only one.
Brilliant running! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
Change of ends for Akeal Hosein. 15 runs came off his 2 overs.
A good bumper to end! Reeza ducks under it. A good over for South Africa. 108 needed in 90 balls.
FOUR! Up and over! Slightly short and it sits up to be hit. Reeza pulls this over the mid-wicket fielder. Races away to the fence. Reeza looks in some form.
Another one on the pads, Rassie flicks it through square leg for one.
Up and over! Shorter and outside off, Reeza plays it over covers. Not right off the middle and hence, it does not go to the fence. Three taken.
Yet again on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one more.
A single to begin Russell's spell! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Andre Russell comes into the attack.

On a good length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen nudges it to through mid-wicket. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably. Kieron Pollard runs hard from mid on but could not prevent the second run.
On middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for another single.
On a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to deep square leg. A single.
Good-length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it on the off side off the backfoot.
On a length, on middle. Reeza Hendricks tucks it off the hips to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Reeza Hendricks is looking in a good touch! Short of a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks hangs back, waits for the ball to come and plays it late to the third man region for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, on middle, at 100 kph. Rassie van der Dussen stabs the ball towards mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, played to mid-wicket.

Short and on leg. That was very quick from Akeal Hosein. Rassie van der Dussen looks to work it on the leg side. The ball goes off the leading edge and falls just short of Kieron Pollard at mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Brilliant batting! Akeal Hosein now shortens his length, on middle. Reeza Hendricks stays deep in his crease and swivel-pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Full and on middle, in the hitting arc. Reeza Hendricks stands still and launches it over long on for a biggie. He reaches to 1000 T20I runs as well.
A dot to end! Good-length ball, on top of off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it on the off side. A tidy over from Ravi Rampaul. Only 2 runs from it.
Back of a length, on off. Reeza Hendricks stands up on his toes and eases it to backward point for a single.
On a good length, on off, coming back in sharply. Reeza Hendricks didn't account for the movement. He gets hit on the thigh pad trying to play outside the line.
On middle, Hendricks works it through mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length, outside off, at 133 kph. Rassie van der Dussen prods and punches it through covers. Gets off the mark with a single.
Good-length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen comes forward and tucks it on the leg side.
Rassie van der Dussen walks out to bat. Also, Ravi Rampaul to bowl from the other end.

OUT! RUN OUT! Flatter ball, angling it on the pads. Temba Bavuma rocks back and works it to mid on. He scampers across for a quick single. Andre Russell picks the ball quickly and throws it in one motion at the bowler's end. He scores a direct hit at the stumps. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replay shows Temba Bavuma is caught well short and has to walk back to the pavilion. Great work from Andre Russell and South Africa lose their first wicket. Just the kind of start West Indies needed.
A decision for run out has been sent upstairs! Temba Bavuma might well be short of his crease as there was a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Angling it on the pads, Reeza Hendricks nudges it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Quicker ball, on middle, at 100 kph. Temba Bavuma knocks it in front of mid on for a single.
Shortens his length, on middle. Reeza Hendricks gets off the mark as well by tucking it through mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Temba Bavuma clips it to square leg for a single. South Africa and Temba Bavuma are underway!
